metadata.question: Between January 29 and February 5, 2019, was there at least a 30 degree Celcius difference in the highest daily air temperature at 2 meters in Boston, MA?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about air temperature at 2 meters height in Boston, MA between January 29 and February 5, 2019. They want to know if there was at least a 30°C difference in the highest daily air temperature during this period. For this question, I need to: 1. Use ERA5-Land data which provides 2m temperature data 2. Define Boston, MA geometry 3. Filter for the date range January 29 to February 5, 2019 4. Calculate maximum daily temperature for each day 5. Find the range (max - min) of these daily maximum temperatures 6. Check if the range is ≥ 30°C Potential issues: - No data available (C1) - All pixels masked (C2) - Invalid temperature values (C3) I'll use ERA5-Land hourly data and compute daily maximum temperatures. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const boston = ee.Geometry.Point([-71.0589, 42.3601]); const startDate = '2019-01-29'; const endDate = '2019-02-06'; // Exclusive end date to include Feb 5 // 2. Data Acquisition - ERA5-Land for 2m temperature const tempCollection = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(boston) .select('temperature_2m'); // Check collection size const collectionSize = tempCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`ERA5-Land images found: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("No temperature data available for the specified period."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate daily maximum temperatures // Group by day and get max temperature for each day const dailyMax = tempCollection .map(function(image) { const date = image.date(); const day = date.format('YYYY-MM-dd'); return image.set('day', day); }) .reduceColumns({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max().group({ groupField: 1, groupName: 'day' }), selectors: ['temperature_2m', 'day'] }); const dailyMaxTemps = dailyMax.get('groups').getInfo(); console.log(`Days with data: ${dailyMaxTemps.length}`); if (dailyMaxTemps.length === 0) { console.log("No valid daily temperature data after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } // Extract temperature values (convert from Kelvin to Celsius) const tempsCelsius = dailyMaxTemps.map(group => group.max - 273.15); console.log(`Daily max temperatures (°C): ${tempsCelsius.map(t => t.toFixed(1)).join(', ')}`); // 4. Calculation - Find temperature range const maxTemp = Math.max(...tempsCelsius); const minTemp = Math.min(...tempsCelsius); const tempRange = maxTemp - minTemp; console.log(`Max temp: ${maxTemp.toFixed(1)}°C, Min temp: ${minTemp.toFixed(1)}°C`); console.log(`Temperature range: ${tempRange.toFixed(1)}°C`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (isNaN(tempRange) || !isFinite(tempRange) || tempRange < -100 || tempRange > 100) { console.log("Invalid temperature range calculated."); console.log("C3"); } else if (tempRange >= 30) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
